description: The working-paper deposit describes probabilistic forecasts of Finnish heat from combined heat and power using a Temporal Fusion Transformer. The author discusses a residual-from-persistence target and comparison with simpler forecasting baselines. The provider is Rohnonen, Maria. Coverage: The described application uses nine years of hourly Fingrid data for Finland. The first and last data years are not stated in the inspected metadata. Access: The depositor publishes the record and its file listing on Zenodo. Only metadata was read; the files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence and public access. Any separately cited input data retain their own terms. Limitations: The description is a depositor statement, not independent verification of results or reusable software. File completeness and execution remain untested. For simulation it may support demand and generation forecasting experiments under changing plant fleets. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
